description: Maaco is an automobile painting and body repair franchise founded in 1972 by Anthony A. Martino. The franchisor, MAACO FRANCHISOR SPV LLC of Charlotte, North Carolina, is an indirect subsidiary of Driven Brands and has offered Maaco Center franchises since February 1972. Per the 2025 FDD, the initial franchise fee is $45,000, the Auto Body Conversion model requires $196,000 to $644,000 in total investment (Ground Up or Non-Auto Retrofit: $728,500 to $3,994,000), royalties are 8% of gross receipts plus a $1,200 weekly marketing fee, and territories are non-exclusive with density protection of one center per 50,000 people in the market area. Item 19 reports average 2024 gross receipts of $1,615,904 across 317 reporting centers. The system totaled 363 franchised outlets at the end of 2024.
territoryDescription: Non-exclusive. No exclusive territory under the franchise, development, or limited-exclusivity agreements; franchisees may face competition from other franchisees, company outlets, and other channels. Density protection: the franchisor will not license another center in the same Core Based Statistical Area if it would result in more than one Maaco Center per 50,000 persons, provided the franchisee is in compliance. The franchisor and its affiliates retain all rights to establish competing businesses anywhere.

litigation_1.value: PJC Management Group, LLC et al. v. MAACO Franchisor SPV LLC, Driven Brands, Inc., and Driven Systems LLC, Case No. 25-CV-059334-590 (Mecklenburg County Superior Court, NC, filed 11/5/2025) — ten current franchisees allege breach of contract, breach of implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing, and violation of the NC Unfair and Deceptive Trade Practices Act; allege misappropriation/misuse/conversion of advertising and media fees; seek accounting, damages in excess of $1 million, treble damages, and a declaration that non-compete and certain post-termination provisions are null and void; pre-trial; defendants dispute and intend to vigorously defend
